gaps.title: Remove object / erase from video
gaps.higgsfield: Landing /remove-object-from-video ('Remove Object from Video - Erase People & Clutter with AI') opens https://higgsfield.ai/ai/video/edit with Kling 3.0 Omni Edit and a removal prompt (mock composer: Prompt · Kling 3.0 Omni Edit · 1:1 · Remove Object). Copy: 'Describe what to erase ... fills the gap frame by frame'; 'For best results, keep the object clearly visible and the clip short. Need more detail? Run Kling 3.0 Omni Edit in 4K mode.' Example prompts: 'Remove the coffee cup from her hands and fix her fingers so they're just resting naturally, keep everything else the same.' Backend jobs remove_object / swap_object cost 3 / 4.5 / 12 credits/s (480p/720p/1080p) plus frame_credits 3.5 (same shape as draw_to_video: first-frame edit then propagation, inferred); not used by the web client (agents only, inferred). Edit Video copy: 'Edit videos with text prompts', 'Upload an MP4 video to edit', 'This video uses an unsupported codec, such as ProRes. Convert it to H.264 and try again.'
gaps.fuobeNow: STATUS 'Video tools: remove background, relight, depth' row: 'Remove object ⬜ (Edit video with a prompt is the closest)'. bria/video/erase and clean-plate are in paid-model-apis-2 but no studio uses them.
gaps.cloudRoute: Default: Kling O3 edit (fal-ai/kling-video/o3/pro/video-to-video/edit, Higgsfield's own route, already in Fuobe's catalog) with 'Remove {X} ... keep everything else the same' (video 3-15 s, 720-3840 px, <=200 MB, keep_audio default true, $0.168/s); Kling O3 4K edit for 4K. Clicks or a painted mask: bria/video/erase/keypoints or /mask (clips under 5 s; auto_trim default true cuts to 5 s; segment -> erase -> join for longer clips; mask white = erase, inferred). bria/video/erase/prompt names the object. fal-ai/void-video-inpainting for shadows and reflections (<=197 frames). fal-ai/ltx-2.3-quality/clean-plate removes all people only. Kling 4.0 edit is playground-only on fal (2026-10-22).
gaps.openRoute: video-inpaint-wan-vace / -painted (SAM 3.1 track -> Wan 2.1 VACE 14B + the Apache lightx2v 4-step LoRA instead of the template's CC-BY-NC CausVid; pasted back at source resolution) or video-erase-void (VOID, CogVideoX licence caveat); all validated in comfyui-oss-4. Not DiffuEraser: its default pipeline uses ProPainter weights (S-Lab License 1.0, non-commercial) as the prior. Avoid MiniMax-Remover (CC BY-NC 4.0) and the MiniMax-H3 person-remover LoRA.

gaps.title: Kling 4.0 (references, up to 10 keyframes, edit, 3-30 s)
gaps.higgsfield: Launched 2026-10-21. Video -> Kling 4.0 -> References, Frames, or Edit video (code modes: references, keyframes (default), video). Limits from code: KLING_4_0_MIN_DURATION 3, MAX_DURATION 30, MAX_IMAGES 10, MAX_VIDEOS 5, MAX_ELEMENTS 7, MAX_MEDIA_AND_ELEMENTS 15. Copy: 'Up to 10 frames. The first is the start frame.', 'Middle Frame', 'Text to video needs a fixed aspect ratio', 'Image to video takes no videos or elements', 'This mode takes no video to edit'. 720p/1080p, ARs 21:9 to 9:16, stereo audio, voiceover in 9 languages (EN, ES, PT, DE, FR, HI, JA, KO, ZH). Extend an uploaded clip up to 2 minutes (landing FAQ). Credits/s (launch promo): 720p 1.5 (list 2.75 without video, 3.25 with video), 1080p 2 without video / 2.5 with video (list 4 / 5). Landing also names Kling 4.0 Flash (720p, <=20 s drafts) and 4K 10-bit HDR; neither exists in code (unverified). Also inside Cinema Studio.
gaps.fuobeNow: Not in the catalog (no kling4/kling/v4 ids in src/lib/catalog). STATUS 'Create Video' lists Kling 3.0 / O3 / O1 / 2.6 / 2.5.
gaps.cloudRoute: BLOCKED: fal kling/v4/{text-to-video,image-to-video,reference-to-video,video-to-video/edit} are listed (2026-10-16) but playground-only: 'Kling 4.0 is available in the playground and fal Agent. API access is coming soon.' (llms.txt and catalog, 2026-10-22). Not on Replicate or the Higgsfield API. Schemas when it opens: t2v prompt (<=26,000 chars) or multi_prompt, duration 3-30 (default 5), aspect 16:9/9:16/1:1/21:9, resolution 720p/1080p (default 1080p), $0.157/s 720p, $0.235/s 1080p; i2v start_image_url + end_image_url only (no 3-10 keyframes); ref2v image_urls <=10, elements <=7, video_urls <=5 (3-30 s each, 30 s combined), aspect auto/16:9/9:16/1:1/21:9; edit video_url 3-30 s, <=300 MB, 700-4553 px each side, image_urls <=10, elements <=7, $0.094/s 720p input+output. Callable now for the keyframes mode: blackforestlabs/flux-3-max/keyframes-to-video (1-10 keyframes as {image_url, frame_index} at 24 fps, 5-20 s, 720p/1080p, audio).
gaps.openRoute: LTX-2.5 with one core LTXVAddGuide per keyframe (frame_idx) or KJNodes LTXVAddGuidesFromBatch (not built); or Wan 2.2 FLF chained per keyframe pair (already built for storyboards; Comfy template templates-6-key-frames).

gaps.title: Video upscale option sets, FPS Boost, SDR to HDR, pro codecs
gaps.higgsfield: Video tools menu (8): Edit Video, Extend, Reframe, Upscale, Remove Background, SDR to HDR (New), FPS Boost (New), Depth Map (New). Upscale models: FLUX.3 Upscale (output 720p/1080p/2K default/4K limited to source; Creativity Precise default / Creative; prompt 'Describe details to preserve or enhance'; <=20 s, <=50 MB MP4; cost by source->target, e.g. 720p->4K 8 credits/s precise); Topaz Starlight Precise (1080p / 4K default; frame rate Original default/24/30/60/120); ByteDance Upscale (Standard/Pro; 1080p default/2K/4K/8K; 30/60 fps; presets Common default, AIGC, Short Series, UGC, Old Film; <=600 s, <=50 MB); Topaz Video (Original/1k default/2k/4K; presets Starlight Precise 2.5, Proteus default, Artemis, Iris, Rhea, Gaia, Theia; fps Original/24/30/60/120; <=50 MB). SDR to HDR: Topaz Hyperion 2.5, output H.265 10-bit (default) / ProRes 10-bit / EXR 16-bit, <=60 s, <=100 MB, dimensions multiple of 4, 2.6 credits/s (<=1080p) / 5.2 (2K/4K). FPS Boost: Topaz, 24/30/60 default/90/120 FPS, <=100 MB; 3.3 credits/s from 24 fps (5.5 at 2K/4K), 4.1/6.9 from 30, 8.1/13.7 from 60, 12/20.5 from 90. Output capped at 13.75 MP per frame. 'EXR archives are too large to bundle. Download them one at a time.' FLUX 3 Video Upscaler got a new build on 2026-10-15 ('sharper detail ... fewer credits').
gaps.fuobeNow: STATUS 'Upscale video (+ FPS boost, SDR→HDR, pro codecs)' 🟡: 'Upscaling only. FPS boost, SDR→HDR and ProRes / EXR output ⬜ (the open RIFE interpolation model runs only from a Canvas model node)'. Cloud: Topaz Video, SeedVR2 Video.
gaps.cloudRoute: FPS: topaz/interpolate/video (target_fps 16-120 default 60, slowdown_factor 1-8, model Apollo/Chronos/Aion, H264_output false -> H.265); fallbacks fal-ai/rife/video, fal-ai/film/video. HDR: topaz/sdr-to-hdr/video (output_format mp4 = 10-bit H.265 HDR10, prores = 10-bit ProRes 422). Upscale: blackforestlabs/flux-video-upscale; topaz/upscale/video/{precision,generative,creative}. Codecs: fal FFmpeg compose/transcode (EXR via frame export, unverified). EXR and plain (SDR) ProRes have no hosted transcode: EXR frames only from fal-ai/ltx-2.3-quality/hdr (exr_frames_url) or Luma Ray 3.2 exr_export; ProRes only as an output option of topaz/sdr-to-hdr/video (422 HQ) and Bria video endpoints (mov_proresks). The Fuobe server runs no ffmpeg today, so a cloud-only install needs a new ffmpeg dependency or the open engine's video-export-pro.
gaps.openRoute: interpolate-rife (native RIFE 4.26, ran on CPU) offered in the studio; exact Higgsfield targets by FrameInterpolate multiplier m then VHS_SelectEveryNthImage n with src*m/n = target (24->60: m 5, n 2; 24->30: m 5, n 4; 30->60: m 2; 30->90: m 3; 30->120: m 4; 60->90: m 3, n 2); video-export-pro (VHS ProRes lt..4444xq, H.265 10-bit, FFV1), video-export-exr (core SaveImageAdvanced exr, 16-bit float), video-sdr-to-hdr (core ImageSDRToHDR, algorithmic, 10-bit HLG) - all ran on CPU in comfyui-oss-4; learned SDR->HDR: Lightricks/LTX-2.5-22b-IC-LoRA-SDR-To-HDR (2026-09-28, LTX-2.x community licence; not built).

gaps.title: Genjutsu as a full user flow on both engines, plus Genjutsu Lite
gaps.higgsfield: Modes Motion transfer / Objects swap / Restyle. Copy: 'The movement and camera stay exactly as filmed. Swap in your character.'; 'Object swap accepts image references only'; Restyle 'Pick a style or bring your own image. Every frame takes the look — motion, camera, and framing stay as filmed.' Source 4-30 s ('trimmed to 30 seconds', '<4 s extended to 4 seconds'); up to 10 reference images; custom Restyle look from up to 8 images (RESTYLE_CUSTOM_PRESET_IMAGE_LIMIT); 480/720/1080p; batch ('Batch of {n} with no extra cost' on promos). Credits/s 3 / 7 / 20. Genjutsu Lite (2026-10-19; jobs hf_mult_motion_control_flash / hf_mult_replace_object_flash): Motion transfer + Objects swap only, up to 10 images, 720p/1080p, 1 / 2 / 4 credits/s now (list 3 / 6 / 12); web code allows 4-30 s, the changelog and API say 4-15 s. Free generations run in a shared queue. Recreate examples; Community trending/new presets (login-gated list); setups shareable by code (/genjutsu/shared/$code). API: genjutsu/{motion-transfer,object-swap}/v1.0 from $0.318/s, genjutsu-light/{motion-transfer,object-swap}/v1.0 from $0.050/s.
gaps.fuobeNow: STATUS 'Genjutsu (motion transfer, object swap, restyle)' 🟢 cloud · ⬜ open ('Motion control and Shorts restyle on Wan are the closest'). No Genjutsu Lite.
gaps.cloudRoute: Higgsfield API genjutsu/* and genjutsu-light/* (with a key); without a key: Kling 4.0 video-to-video/edit (swap character/product/background), Kling 3.0 Motion Control (motion transfer), the Shorts restyle models (restyle).
gaps.openRoute: Motion transfer: Wan Animate 2 (already in Motion Control). Object swap: SAM 3.1 mask of the named object -> Wan 2.2 Fun VACE inpaint with the reference image. Restyle: first-frame restyle with Qwen-Image-Edit 2511 -> Wan 2.2 Fun VACE restyle (the Shorts chain).

Job cinematic_studio_image_3d = 3 credits -> result type image_3d shown in a Gaussian-splat viewer (ThreeDSceneModal; Spark-style renderer, inferred). gaps.title: Content Factory: faceless short-video series from a trending reference
gaps.higgsfield: New top-nav item 'Content Factory · New' (/content-factory, nav id 'What If'). 'Generate viral faceless short videos'. Generate with: 'Generate in Claude' (needs Higgsfield MCP; POST /what-if/compose builds the message, inputs <=64 KB, opens Claude with ?q= or offers copy) or 'Generate here'. Add reference: images/videos or 'Add TikTok or Instagram link'; 'Select from presets'. Prompt 'Make a video about…' with examples 'What if cars could fly', 'What if cats ruled the world', 'What if the Moon had a city', 'What if dinosaurs never went extinct', 'What if gravity switched off for a day'. Length default 30 sec (strings for 1-5 min). Episodes default 1. 'Pick a trending style to start from' grid of real Instagram/TikTok videos with views and likes ('Use as reference'). Styles: Fully animated, Frame by Frame, Scene by scene video, Seamless motion video. Genres: Storytelling, Education, Kids ('Bright, simple, and safe'), history ('Retell what actually happened'). Series: 'Next episode topic', 'Previous episode'. Pricing: 'Final cost depends on video complexity and is settled once your video is generated.' Faceless job youtube_faceless_video costs 41 credits per 10 s fully animated, 16 per 10 s scene-based.
gaps.fuobeNow: Faceless Studio 🟢 and Explainer 🟡 exist; no trend reference grid, no link import, no multi-episode series, no 'run in Claude' handoff.
gaps.cloudRoute: Fuobe Faceless pipeline (Nano Banana Pro stills, Gemini Omni Flash, ElevenLabs, Sonilo) with an episode planner on Claude; reference analysis = frames + transcript (Scribe v2) -> Claude style brief.
gaps.openRoute: Same open Faceless pipeline (Z-Image / Qwen-Image-Edit, Wan 2.2 Lightning, Chatterbox, ACE-Step + audio-loop-crossfade for long beds, kenburns-still for Frame by frame); reference analysis with reference-brief-gemma4 (core TextGenerate with Gemma 4 E4B reading the frames at 1 fps and the soundtrack in one call; validated) or Qwen3-VL on Ollama. ComfyUI v0.41's Qwen3.5 encoder ignores a video input.
